summary:
Investment Risk Associate at JP Morgan Asset & Wealth Management with direct exposure to a $640B AUM multi-
asset book. Deep expertise in quantitative portfolio analytics, factor risk decomposition, Python-driven automation,
and stress testing across equity, fixed income, and multi-asset strategies. CFA Level I cleared at the 90th percentile;
Level II cleared (Level III candidate). IIM Indore MBA, top 2% in Finance. Seeking buy-side investment risk, quant
research, or portfolio analytics roles where rigorous quantitative skills and institutional markets experience can drive
alpha generation and risk-adjusted performance.

bullets: Owned daily quantitative risk reporting across CIO-managed portfolios (~$640B AUM); decomposed factor exposures (value, momentum, quality, duration) to surface concentration risk and support intraday rebalancing decisions by senior PMs

Rebuilt equity, fixed income, and multi-asset analytics stack in Python (Pandas, NumPy) — automated tracking error, information ratio, and excess return attribution pipelines, reducing turnaround from 4+ hours to under 30 minutes and enabling same-day portfolio adjustments

Conducted quantitative due diligence on prospective investment solutions: built VaR models, drawdown scenario matrices, and tail-risk simulations to evaluate suitability against client risk mandates and regulatory constraints

Back-tested factor strategies and scenario-modelled macro shocks (rate hikes, credit spread widening, equity drawdowns) alongside senior PMs, directly informing systematic capital allocation decisions
Identified concentrated factor tilts across sector allocations during volatile macro periods; escalated tail-risk flags that contributed to pre-emptive defensive repositioning in client portfolios

Managed a product line generating ~₹30M monthly revenue; led data-driven pricing model redesign and scenario analysis to guide capital allocation, achieving 15% YoY growth and measurable churn reduction
Collaborated with Finance and Sales to align P&L roadmap with profitability targets; translated market data into actionable pricing strategy and cross-segment expansion initiatives

Executed end-to-end financial due diligence on 5+ early-stage startups across APAC and the US; built DCF, precedent transaction, and comparable company models to estimate enterprise value and flag structural risks
Assessed unit economics, capital structure viability, and scalability profiles to support investment committee decisions on angel and VC-stage deals
Built LBO models to evaluate acquisition IRR and debt service coverage across leverage scenarios; designed financial forecasting tools to support capital raising for legal-fintech investments
